host_count_scope: Number of baseline answers containing a displayed link from each host, deduplicated per answer; hosts overlap. These are not engine retrieval logs or independent-review counts.

distribution_observation.source: Server-rendered visible body text, scripts excluded
distribution_observation.scope: Observed third-party listing lag, not proof that Gemini or Claude read or rejected this listing.

search_service_observation.scope: Search-service snapshot, not a complete Google/Bing index audit or a Gemini/Claude trace.

hypothesis: Candidate retrieval/ordering and source-distribution gaps are plausible upstream bottlenecks; their exact contribution to the 16 misses is not identified.
limits: No current retrieval trace was recovered from the retained UI tabs; only saved answer observations are available.
No general engine indexing claim follows from a site-operator miss.
No causal GEO lift or failure can be inferred from the immediate post-deployment recheck.
No private source identifiers or account data are included.
